_what: A room brought onto the street by tools/import-room.py from an artifact somebody built with their own AI. Everything here is read off that artifact's FOR THE STREET comment or measured from the room as it renders; nothing is typed. check-contrast.py holds the pairs, check-jukebox.py checks the tracks, and re-importing replaces this file whole.
title: NeuroHome
description: Isha Snow's tiny home by the river: daylight through the firs, candles, a full bookshelf, a radio on the desk, a creativity corner and a bee yard out front.
name: Isha Snow
light: Daylight through tall firs and flashing off the river, with candles set all through the house.
words: Isha chose everything in the room and gave its facts, lists, titles and links. The house specifications are from the NeuroHomes Community Design Standards, and the community cards from neurohomes.org, both shortened. The short lines of description in each section are drafts by Claude that Isha reviewed and edited.
built_with: Claude, an AI made by Anthropic
could_not_do: The NeuroHomes concept art and videos were made with an image generator, so none of it is used; every picture here is drawn by hand in SVG.
